name: Magma Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Magma Group Berhad 完成了以 RM63.00 million 出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 全部20%股权的交易，并通过持股80%的子公司 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 以 RM2.8 million 收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd，从而进入食品相关业务。此外，公司于3月与卖方签订 Heads of Agreement，但该协议于11月双方同意终止。
overview_en: In 2026, Magma Group Berhad completed the disposal of its entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd for RM63.00 million and, through its 80%-owned subsidiary Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd, acquired Magma Christine Sdn Bhd for RM2.8 million, entering a food-related business. Separately, the company entered into a Heads of Agreement with vendors in March, which was mutually terminated in November.

segments.name: 房地产投资
segments.note: 今年完成了出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 全部20%股权的交易。
segments.note_en: The disposal of the entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd was completed this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 20%股权予 Harum Aspirasi Sdn Bhd 的交易于2026年9月1日完成。
actions.text_en: The disposal of the 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd to Harum Aspirasi Sdn Bhd was completed on 1 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 20%股权的条件先决条件（经济部批准）于2026年6月11日达成，协议变为无条件。
actions.text_en: The condition precedent (approval from the Ministry of Economy) for the disposal of the 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd was fulfilled on 11 June 2026, and the SSA became unconditional.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DISPOSAL OF THE ENTIRE 20% EQUITY INTEREST IN HERITAGE LANE SDN BHD BY ASTAKA MEKAR SDN
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of the entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM63.00 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年签订了 Heads of Agreement 但随后双方同意终止，并通过子公司收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd 进入食品业务。
segments.note_en: A Heads of Agreement was entered into this year but subsequently mutually terminated, and the group acquired Magma Christine Sdn Bhd through a subsidiary to enter a food business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方决定不继续进行 Heads of Agreement，并同意相互终止该协议。
actions.text_en: The parties decided not to proceed with the Heads of Agreement and agreed to mutually terminate it.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 持股80%的子公司 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 以现金 RM2,800,000 收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd 全部股权。
actions.text_en: The 80%-owned subsidiary Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd acquired the entire equity interest in Magma Christine Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM2,800,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Magma 与全资子公司 Magma Avenue Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年3月5日与卖方签订 Heads of Agreement。
actions.text_en: Magma and its wholly-owned subsidiary Magma Avenue Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Heads of Agreement with the vendors on 5 March 2026.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过持股80%的子公司 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd，进入食品相关业务。
model_changes.text_en: Entered a food-related business through the acquisition of Magma Christine Sdn Bhd by its 80%-owned subsidiary Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 完成出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 全部20%股权，退出该投资。
model_changes.text_en: Completed the disposal of the entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd, exiting the investment.
